open_questions: fn_080eb9a4(handle) returns a record used both as a weapon definition (fireType, pelletCount, launchSpeedInt) and as an entity-like object (objType, linkChildren, nextLink); its identity and full size need the owning chunk (lookup function and callers) to confirm.

MsgStream_ReadCompressed and MsgStream_WriteCompressed (FUN_08122df8 / FUN_0812308a) implement a run-length protocol with control classes 0x00/0x40/0x80/0xc0; the class semantics are read from the control flow only, and the writer rewrites the previous control byte in place. Validate against the msg writer/reader pair in the merge.
G_UpdateLookAtTrigger reads the trace surfaceFlags at trace+0x10 by stack-slot aliasing (local_3c is inside the trace written by fn_0810a5cc); confirm the trace_t layout from the trace routine chunk.

Curve_Create copies row 0 values into the synthesized leading and trailing rows (FUN_08123f3c reads param_1[k+1] for both). Confirm this is the intended behaviour and not a binary defect before relying on the extra rows.

Float precision: helpers that return x87 values unrounded are declared long double (Math_Lerp, Vec3_Dot, Math_Square, Vec3_LengthSquared, Curve_TrapezoidArea, Curve_InterpolateSegment); float-only returns (Math_Sqrt, Math_Max, Math_SelectNonNegative, fn_080a4424) are float. Mixed float/double expressions depend on GCC excess-precision handling.
G_FireWeaponByMode and G_FireWeaponShot pass float bits through int parameters (aim angle) exactly as the binary does; the callee fn_0811fac8 interprets the first argument per the merged prototype.
